application_calendar_events_meet_referen.name: application_calendar_events_meet_reference_check
application_calendar_events_meet_referen.value: "application_calendar_events"."meet_url_ciphertext" is null or "application_calendar_events"."conference_request_id" is not null

application_calendar_events_synced_at_ch.name: application_calendar_events_synced_at_check
application_calendar_events_synced_at_ch.value: ("application_calendar_events"."sync_status" = 'active' and "application_calendar_events"."synced_at" is not null) or ("application_calendar_events"."sync_status" <> 'active' and "application_calendar_events"."synced_at" is null)

application_calendar_events_error_state_.name: application_calendar_events_error_state_check
application_calendar_events_error_state_.value: ("application_calendar_events"."sync_status" in ('create_pending', 'active') and "application_calendar_events"."last_error_code" is null) or ("application_calendar_events"."sync_status" in ('failed', 'reconnect_required') and "application_calendar_events"."last_error_code" is not null)

billing_checkout_sessions_application_mo.name: billing_checkout_sessions_application_mode_check
billing_checkout_sessions_application_mo.value: ("billing_checkout_sessions"."mode" = 'payment' and "billing_checkout_sessions"."application_id" is not null) or ("billing_checkout_sessions"."mode" = 'subscription' and "billing_checkout_sessions"."application_id" is null)

google_calendar_connections_token_state_.name: google_calendar_connections_token_state_check
google_calendar_connections_token_state_.value: ("google_calendar_connections"."status" = 'active' and "google_calendar_connections"."refresh_token_ciphertext" is not null) or ("google_calendar_connections"."status" <> 'active' and "google_calendar_connections"."refresh_token_ciphertext" is null)

member_auth_accounts_temporary_expiry_ch.name: member_auth_accounts_temporary_expiry_check
member_auth_accounts_temporary_expiry_ch.value: ("member_auth_accounts"."password_state" = 'temporary' and "member_auth_accounts"."temporary_password_expires_at" is not null) or ("member_auth_accounts"."password_state" = 'personal' and "member_auth_accounts"."temporary_password_expires_at" is null)

member_lesson_progress_completed_at_chec.name: member_lesson_progress_completed_at_check
member_lesson_progress_completed_at_chec.value: ("member_lesson_progress"."completed" = 1 and "member_lesson_progress"."completed_at" is not null) or ("member_lesson_progress"."completed" = 0 and "member_lesson_progress"."completed_at" is null)
